title: Normalized right adjoints of coefficient-tower evaluation
statement: Let $l$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_l$ a finite extension, $T$ a scheme, and $A$ the sectionwise normalized strict-system equivalence and abelian data of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. For every nonnegative index $n$, evaluation on the coefficient-tower category [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian] has a right adjoint specified on strict systems: at $r\ge n$ it is scalar restriction of $J$ along the coefficient map from level $r+1$ to level $n+1$; at $r<n$ it is zero. All iterated transitions above $n$ are identity section maps, transitions into lower levels are zero, and maps act by the prescribed scalar restrictions above $n$ and zero below. The actual right adjoint is this functor composed with the inverse of the given equivalence. No exactness or injectivity assertion is included.

proof.text: Construct the functor for an arbitrary coefficient-ring diagram. At every level at least n use quotient scalar restriction of J, and below n use a categorical zero object. The quotient maps compose. The canonical restrictionScalarsComp isomorphism gives identity section maps for upper transitions; heterogeneous transport lemmas prove their identity and composition laws without unfolding the coefficient rings. Zero targets handle the boundary. Apply maps componentwise; naturality of restrictionScalarsComp proves compatibility, and scalar-restriction functoriality proves the functor laws.

Given C_n to J, restrict it and precompose with the transition C_r to Res C_n at every upper level, and use zero below. The strict composition law proves tower compatibility. Evaluation at n followed by the canonical identity-restriction counit recovers the original map by the strict identity law. Conversely this counit is invertible and all upper transitions of the extension are invertible, so tower compatibility and cancellation show a tower map is determined by its nth component. These constructions are natural on the left by componentwise composition and on the right by naturality of the identity-restriction counit. Form Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv and compose with A.equivalence.toAdjunction. All six normalizations follow from the construction.

proof_origin.place: Well-defined and Adjunction; explicit generic coefficient-ring construction, transport identities, normalized Hom equivalence and equivalence adjunction, implemented and proved by Z5.

mathlib_searches.query: Evaluation of inverse systems of module sheaves over varying rings has a right adjoint zero below the evaluated index and restriction of scalars above
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits, including PresheafOfModules limit constructions and SheafOfModules.evaluation; no normalized varying-ring right extension.
3 hits: Adjunction.map_injective, Injective.injective_of_adjoint and Adjunction.injective_of_map_injective. These give the injective consequence, not the right extension construction.

Evaluation adjunctions in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Evaluation are for a fixed target category; none gives the prescribed varying-ring functor. Local rg also found systemScalarRestriction_exact in SystemLevelLeftExtension.
